lesson.title: 7.9 Three Everyday Situations
lesson.unit_title: Unit 7: Everyday Needs and A1 Integration
lesson.unit_outcome: Consolidate all A1 foundational competencies: introduce oneself, describe people and objects, state feelings and needs, discuss routines and weather, give simple directions, and handle everyday communication repair.
lesson.lesson_title: Unit 7: Everyday Needs and A1 Integration
lesson.goal: Retrieve the expanded body, clothing, weather, preference and repair language through fresh everyday situations.
lesson.grammar_function: Retrieve Unit 7 language in three fresh, coherent everyday situations.
lesson.speaking_outcome: Retrieve the expanded body, clothing, weather, preference and repair language through fresh everyday situations.

storyboard.ready: Fresh cast: Diego prepares for a cold outing. A body-identification mirror sequence establishes the head-to-toe map, then fingers and toes motivate gloves and boots. A packing scene names a coat, sweater and scarf. Separate sunny/hot and rainy transfers are explicitly labelled, never sudden weather changes. Scenes are review-only. Two healthy existing review photographs retain the dress/skirt and shoes/socks contrasts; all new story photographs have original sources and receipts.
storyboard.friends: A separate visit with Sofía and friends. Questions identify exactly whose feeling is discussed; food and water needs receive a response. They share indoor, creative and outdoor interests, then decline football and agree on music. Each preference comes from an utterance, never a guessed facial expression.
storyboard.route: A different visitor travels to the park. They check a time, ask for repetition and slower directions, then reach the friends. Keep this encounter internally continuous.
